q1.question: Can I change my plan anytime?
q1.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes will be reflected in your next billing cycle.

q2.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q2.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers for enterprise customers.

q3.question: Is there a free trial available?
q3.answer: Yes, Premium plans come with a 7-day free trial. No credit card required to start your trial.

q4.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q4.answer: Absolutely! You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.

q5.question: What happens to my data if I cancel?
q5.answer: Your data will be retained for 30 days after cancellation, giving you time to export or reactivate your account if needed.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By accessing or using the FormMaps platform ("Service"), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you are using the Service on behalf of a school or organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that entity to these terms.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.body: FormMaps provides a career development and assessment platform for students, schools, counselors, coaches, and parents. Features include personality and cognitive assessments, career matching, university recommendations, course planning, resume building, and AI-powered insights.

s3.title: 3. User Accounts
s3.item1: You must provide accurate and complete information when creating an account
s3.item2: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials
s3.item3: You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized access to your account
s3.item4: One person may not maintain more than one account of the same role type

s4.title: 4. Subscriptions and Payments
s4.item1: Individual students may access premium features through paid subscriptions
s4.item2: School-affiliated students receive access through their school's subscription
s4.item3: Payments are processed securely through Stripe
s4.item4: Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled before the billing date
s4.item5: Refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis within 14 days of purchase

s5.title: 5. Acceptable Use
s5.item1: Use the Service for any unlawful purpose
s5.item2: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to other users' accounts or data
s5.item3: Submit false or misleading assessment responses
s5.item4: Use automated tools to scrape or collect data from the platform
s5.item5: Interfere with or disrupt the Service's infrastructure
s5.item6: Share your account credentials with others

s6.title: 6. Intellectual Property
s6.body: The Service, including all content, features, and functionality, is owned by FormMaps and protected by copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws. Assessment content, scoring algorithms, and AI-generated insights are proprietary.

s7.title: 7. Disclaimers
s7.item1: Career recommendations and university matches are suggestions based on assessment data, not guarantees of admission or employment
s7.item2: AI-generated insights are for informational purposes and should not replace professional counseling
s7.item3: The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.intro: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account, completing assessments, or using our platform:
s1.item1: name, email address, school affiliation, grade level, role
s1.item2: responses to personality (PCA), labor intelligence (MIL/LIA), and 360-degree evaluations
s1.item3: transcripts, test scores, GPA, course plans
s1.item4: career interests, university preferences, resume content
s1.item5: pages visited, features used, session duration

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.item1: Deliver personalized career guidance, university recommendations, and course suggestions
s2.item2: Generate AI-powered insights based on your assessment results
s2.item3: Enable school administrators and counselors to support your development
s2.item5: Send transactional emails (invitations, reminders, password resets)
s2.item6: Improve our platform through anonymized analytics

s3.title: 3. Data Sharing
s3.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with:
s3.item1: administrators and counselors at your affiliated school can view your assessment results and academic progress
s3.item3: parents, teachers, and peers you invite to provide feedback

s4.title: 4. Data Security
s4.item1: Encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS) for all data in transit
s4.item3: HttpOnly secure cookies for authentication tokens
s4.item4: Role-based access controls with permission validation

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.item1: Access your personal data through your profile and dashboard
s5.item2: Correct inaccurate information in your profile settings
s5.item3: Request deletion of your account and associated data
s5.item4: Export your assessment results and reports

s6.title: 6. Cookies
s6.body: We use essential cookies for authentication (httpOnly secure cookies) and a non-httpOnly login status cookie. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

s7.title: 7. Children's Privacy
s7.body: Our platform is designed for use by students in grades 9-12. Students under 13 may only use the platform through their school with parental consent. We comply with applicable children's privacy regulations including COPPA.

s8.title: 8. Contact
s8.body: For privacy-related inquiries, contact us at <link>privacy@formmaps.ai</link>.

sample.summaryText: Valentina shows two exceptional cognitive markers: Detection of Characteristics = 96% (Exceptional) and Spatial Orientation / Visualization = Exceptional (78%). Her PCA shows high Influence, a service orientation, a strong concern for quality, and low Dominance. In simple terms: she has a keen eye for detail, can visualize in 2D/3D with ease, and relates very well to others — making her an ideal candidate for Architecture, Industrial Design, and programs that combine design with technical precision.
sample.step1: Translate LIA and PCA results into clear study recommendations.
sample.step2: Prioritize majors (top 10) with a cognitive-behavioral justification.
sample.step3: Provide an exploration and decision plan (0–12 months) for the student.
sample.step4: Deliver an immediate operational plan (8 weeks) and tracking KPIs.
sample.step5: Map recommended universities and facilitate immediate application actions.

detection.title: Detection of characteristics

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Verbal fluency and logical analysis: useful for argumentation, problem solving and presenting proposals.

numerical.title: Numerical speed and accuracy
numerical.description: Agility for practical calculations; sufficient for basic technical tasks.

memory.title: Working memory
memory.description: Retention and manipulation of information; for Valentina it is adequate, and it is advisable to support it with tools.

orientation.title: Orientation / General visualization
orientation.description: Mental rotation, interpretation of plans and 3D prototyping — a differentiating ability for spatially oriented majors.

strengths.title: Strengths:

opportunities.title: Opportunities:
opportunities.description: Her reasoning and verbal skills are good and can grow even more.

stable.title: Stable Areas:

risks.title: Risks:

needs.title: Needs:

architecture.title: Architecture

civilEngineering.title: Civil Engineering
civilEngineering.description: Plan reading, site control and technical management.

majors.complementary2: UX/UI with physical prototyping / 3D product focus

routine.category: Programs that rely exclusively on repetitive routines with little visualization

phase1.title: Quick confirmation
phase1.activities: Intensive SketchUp and AutoCAD course (20–40 h); drawing workshop (10–20 h); one-day job shadowing at a studio/workshop.
phase1.kpi: enjoys at least 2 of the 3 activities.

phase2.title: Minimum portfolio
phase2.activities: Create 2 projects: (A) plan + elevation + 3D view of a space; (B) documented object/prototype.

phase3.title: Technical validation
phase3.kpi: improved portfolio and positive feedback from 1 professional.

phase4.title: Decision and admission
phase4.activities: Select 2–4 programs (1–2 reach schools, 1–2 safe options). Prepare the final portfolio, letters and admission tests.
phase4.kpi: applications submitted to at least 2 programs.

week3.text: Execute the first draft; feedback session with a mentor.

week5.text: 3D modeling; second round of feedback and adjustments.

week7.text: Present portfolio version 1; list target universities; prepare admission steps.
